entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Tract (the Douay Ps 21 through this missal), revised against the Latin in contemporary language: will (the futures), they hoped in You (the third speravérunt), scorned (aspernabántur), they themselves considered and looked closely at me (Ipsi vero consideravérunt, et inspexérunt me), divided (divisérunt), magnify (magnificáte).
